validation.library: Windows-native /W4 /WX shared MT library; accepted lower models reused

implementation.scope: Round/pad decimal digits with exponent carry; scientific and fixed text layout with live locale separator/option/template, guards errno22/34, own frames and actual bounded-string/move/fill/fatal lower APIs. Software conversion and main formatter remain separate; generic ABI/native/fault/MMIO/concurrency/runtime remain bounded.
